data.one_liner: Animate multiple widgets flying to target positions simultaneously in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows animating multiple widgets simultaneously to one or more targets using customizable paths, pre-phase spread animations, effects, and decorative particle trails.
use_when: You need to animate items like coins or shopping items flying into a cart or wallet.
You want custom paths like bezier curves or parabolas for moving UI elements.
You need particle or star trail effects attached to moving widgets.
avoid_when: You are looking for page routing or navigation animations between screens.
You need standard state-driven implicit or explicit UI transitions without flying targets.
strengths: Supports multiple animation paths like linear, parabolic, and bezier curves.
Includes pre-phase spread animations and various decorative particle effects.
Provides a controller-based API with progress-based callback triggers.
weaknesses: Relies on imperative controller usage rather than purely declarative widget trees.
Target and item positions heavily depend on GlobalKeys.

alternatives.name: animations
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose animations for standard Material motion patterns like container transforms and shared axis transitions.
